correctness.rationale: For fixed s,t>0, periodic positive ground-state phi=(1,r,r,1) with r=(s-t+sqrt(4+(s-t)^2))/2 gives a nonnegative exact discrete form for L-J_q with boundary t|v_0|^2/2. Four-edge resistance S=2/r+1/(sr^2)+1/t and mass mbar=(1+r^2)/2 give alpha=2/(S mbar)=2st/[L(s+t)D], kappa=L^2 alpha. With h=(-log q)^(1/3), bounded O(h^2) energy gives local H1 control, zero boundary trace, and uniform mass tightness via the confining damping potential. Its liminf dominates the Dirichlet Airy form alpha int|gprime|^2+L int x|g|^2; linear resistance-minimizing recovery on each complete cell works simultaneously for every fixed k-dimensional test subspace. Two-sided min-max and precompact orthonormal eigenfamilies establish (L-lambda_k)/h^2 -> kappa^(1/3) a_k for EVERY FIXED k; simple Airy eigenspaces yield phase-signed eigenvector envelopes and adjacent spectral gaps. Independently checked rational ground-state and coefficient formulas for (s,t)=(1,1),(2,1/2),(1/2,2) and finite tridiagonal top-three levels at epsilon 10^-3 and 10^-4 converge toward Airy targets; these diagnostics are not infinite proofs.
residual_risks: Exhaustive finite certificates prove only finite objects; the analytic claims require their independently reconstructed universal proofs.
